verdict.rationale: Stable lets users create and manage their own API keys in the dashboard under Settings > API keys, and authenticates with the x-api-key header. So a dedicated key can be issued to an agent and presumably revoked. The pack never shows those keys being scoped to particular resources, actions, or locations. The 'custom roles and permissions' claim covers team mail routing, not API credentials. Missing for 10: per-key permission scopes or read-only keys, per-location or resource restriction, documented key expiry or rotation, and evidence that roles apply to API keys.
